lines.text: Granted you +%1$s & +%2$sx HP, +%3$s & +%4$sx ❈ Defense, +%5$s & +%6$sx ✎ Intelligence, and +%7$s & +%8$sx ❁ Strength.

lines.context: 捡到坚石祝福后的第二行
